# The Cooperative Agency

> The Cooperative Agency is a full-service marketing and sales systems consultancy based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, specializing in automotive dealerships. Backed by two decades of hands-on dealership marketing, sales, and systems experience, we act as a dealership's outsourced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and Marketing Director — aligning creative content, systems, and strategy so every dollar and every lead counts.

You don't need more vendors — you need fewer, smarter true partners. We blend creative horsepower with operational strategy: streamlining vendors, maximizing co-op, and fixing the cracks where leads and dollars get lost. Whether you're a single rooftop or a growing auto group, we'll meet you where you are and build a strategy that fits.

## Services

- **Outsourced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and Marketing Director:** We manage your entire marketing and sales tech stack, aligning creative, tools, and tactics with your business goals, not vendor agendas.
- **Optimize spend and maximize co-op:** We identify waste, clean up lead flow, and manage your co-op claims, so you get every eligible dollar and every lead gets followed up on. Every service is structured to maximize co-op eligibility, with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) compliance in mind, and we even help submit your claims.
- **Social media management and scheduling:** Strategically planned posts across all major platforms, timed to align with promotions, seasons, and what's happening in your market — including local photo and video shoots, Reels and short-form video, OEM-aligned messaging, and consistent multi-platform branding.
- **Brand consistency across all channels:** Your photos, videos, and messaging deployed across Google Business, your website, paid ads, email, and more for a unified brand presence.
- **Vendor management:** We eliminate overlapping services, consolidate your vendor list, and become your single point of contact for all marketing operations.
- **Custom photo and video content:** High-quality, original content that reflects your actual dealership — local settings, real staff, real inventory. No stock images, ever. Drone work is included.
- **Lead and customer relationship management (CRM) fixes:** We're systems people. We diagnose and resolve issues with lead flow, CRM setup, follow-up processes, and more.
- **Fast turnaround:** Creative is built and managed in-house, so we can deploy within hours when needed for sales events, incentives, and urgent updates.

## Who we work with

- Automotive dealerships across the southern region, from Baton Rouge, Louisiana — with boots-on-the-ground content creation and regionalized strategies.
- Premium and luxury brands including Audi, BMW, and multi-location auto groups; our model scales from single-point stores to groups.
- Beyond automotive, we're expanding to support small business startups (website and brand consulting, go-to-market strategy, systems setup) and restaurants (website builds, menu content, photography, and full-platform social media management).
